hints: 50 m/s at 53° is the velocity relative to the gun. Add the trolley’s velocity to get the shell’s velocity relative to the ground; which component does the trolley change?
worded:
1. The shell leaves the barrel at 50 m/s along it (53°), relative to the trolley: 30 m/s horizontal, 40 m/s vertical.

2. Relative to the ground, add the trolley’s 10 m/s forward: 40 m/s horizontal, 40 m/s vertical.

3. Time of flight depends on the vertical part only: 2 × 40/10 = 8 s.

4. Ground range = 40 × 8 = 320 m. (D)

5. Check: from a stationary gun the range would be 2 × 30 × 40/10 = 240 m (option A); the moving trolley adds 10 × 8 = 80 m.
mistakes: The trolley changes only the horizontal component; the time of flight is unchanged (8 s).
